description: This PHP class defines the data structure LDAPUserDataMapping for mapping LDAP user properties to internal representations, including getter/setter methods and conversion utilities.

classes.name: LDAPUserDataMapping
classes.description: A data transfer object for LDAP user attributes mapping, providing customizable attribute names and conversion to array.

methods.name: getFirstNameAttribute
methods.description: Returns the LDAP attribute name used for the user's first name.

methods.name: setFirstNameAttribute
methods.description: Sets the LDAP attribute name used for the user's first name.

methods.name: getMiddleNameAttribute
methods.description: Returns the LDAP attribute name used for the user's middle name, if any.

methods.name: setMiddleNameAttribute
methods.description: Sets the LDAP attribute name for the user's middle name, or null if not used.

methods.name: getLastNameAttribute
methods.description: Returns the LDAP attribute name used for the user's last name.

methods.name: setLastNameAttribute
methods.description: Sets the LDAP attribute name used for the user's last name.

methods.name: getEmployeeIdAttribute
methods.description: Returns the LDAP attribute name used for employee ID, if any.

methods.name: setEmployeeIdAttribute
methods.description: Sets the LDAP attribute name for employee ID, or null if not used.

methods.name: getWorkEmailAttribute
methods.description: Returns the LDAP attribute name used for work email, if any.

methods.name: setWorkEmailAttribute
methods.description: Sets the LDAP attribute name for work email, or null if not used.

methods.name: getUserStatusAttribute
methods.description: Returns the LDAP attribute name used for user status, if any.

methods.name: setUserStatusAttribute
methods.description: Sets the LDAP attribute name for user status, or null if not used.

methods.name: toArray
methods.description: Converts the mapping object into an associative array with attribute names.

methods.name: setAttributeNames
methods.description: Initializes attribute mappings from a provided array of attribute names.
